name: ShowConnections
description: Show connected accounts in user popouts

settings.label: Show GitHub organizations
settings.description: Show GitHub organizations the user is a member of

settings.label: Show on profile modal
settings.description: Show connected accounts in the full-size profile modal

notes: Profiles show connected accounts as a row of icons (size and margin are settings), each with a tooltip of the account name, a check when it is verified, and what clicking does: open the account's page, open Xbox's player page, or copy the name ("Copied to clipboard!"). With Show GitHub organizations, a GitHub account is followed by an icon per organization the user belongs to, from GitHub's public API (api.github.com/users/<name>/orgs, asked once per name while Qord runs).
gaps: Qord has one profile window, which already lists connections; the plugin turns that list into icons, so Show on profile modal has nothing to switch.
The tooltip shows the verified check and the action as text rather than upstream's icons, and Qord's links come from its own platform table rather than Discord's.
